contract: Offline original chunk analysis and local fixed-byte replay only; no production request, no repository edits, no original result promotion.

collectorReadOnlyReview.fsyncLocation: finally only, after EOF or error; not inside the chunk loop
collectorReadOnlyReview.progressElapsedMeaning: Observation immediately after raw write/hash, before this chunk progress JSONL persist. Interchunk intervals include waiting, prior progress persistence and scheduling.

limitations: All measurements here use already saved bytes on the current Windows host. No network, fetch, HTTP server, Cloudflare cache, reader wait, TLS, routing, or abort-timer behavior is replayed.

Original chunk timestamps are after raw write/hash and before progress JSONL persist; interchunk observations mix reader wait, earlier progress writes, scheduling, and collection. They are not exact network arrival times.
Original per-operation instrumentation does not exist. Current local replay cannot attribute historical time to collector, network, Worker, origin, cache, antivirus, disk, or scheduling.
Bodies and chunks are fixed original captured data, including the two partial bodies. Preloading buffers and executing a tight loop differs from an actual asynchronously paced reader.

The minimally instrumented original-like mode reproduces copy/write/hash/counter/clock/JSONL operations with new offline timestamps; fixed-metadata mode reproduces exact original JSONL bytes and adds per-operation instrumentation overhead.
No per-chunk fsync exists in the original. Two fsync calls are only in finally. Finishing-tail observations do not isolate those calls from reader cleanup, file read/hash, or other work.
